decision_conditions: The Local Planning Authority, having regard to its own evidence and in assessing the evidence submitted by the applicant, considers that, on the balance of probabilities, 32A Friern Barnet Road, London, N11 1NA has not operated as a large House in Multiple Occupation HMO (Sui Generis Class) together with a self-contained studio flat at first floor level for a continuous period of 10 years prior to the date of this application and the use is therefore not considered to be lawful under the terms of Section 191 of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by Section 10 of the Planning and Compensation Act 1991.
